mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (member_id, board_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{boardId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM comment as c

SELECT c.*, m.*, COUNT(cl.comment_like_id) AS cln, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM comment_like AS cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.comment_id AND cl.member_id = #{memberId}) AS cls, sc.comment_id AS child_comment_id, sc.parent_id AS child_parent_comment_id, sc.member_id AS child_member_id, sm.nickname AS child_member_nickname, sm.profile_image AS child_member_profile_image, sc.content AS child_content, sc.created_at AS child_created_at, sc.updated_at AS child_updated_at, sc.comment_status AS child_comment_status, COUNT(scl.comment_like_id) AS child_cln, (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM comment_like AS scl WHERE scl.comment_id = sc.comment_id AND scl.member_id = #{memberId}) AS child_cls FROM comment AS c LEFT JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = c.member_id LEFT JOIN comment_like AS cl ON cl.comment_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN comment AS sc ON sc.parent_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN member AS sm ON sm.member_id = sc.member_id LEFT JOIN comment_like AS scl ON scl.comment_id = sc.comment_id WHERE c.board_id = #{boardId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY c.comment_id, sc.comment_id ORDER BY c.created_at, sc.created_at
